title: The Light Extracted from Hyle's Storehouses Leaving Her a Dead Body
description: The First Man molded into a garment and sent into the war; the Living Spirit's archons running after the elements of Darkness; the visible cosmos built as storehouses for the captured darkness, refashioned as receptive form for divine good. Once the living natures are drawn out, what remains is the husk — Hyle as the Death of the Midst, a corpse-substance. Two analogies (the lake; the body whose limbs collapse without the soul) make the state visible.
